name: relay
description: Attempt a verified fresh-thread Goal continuation at automatic compaction, otherwise let Codex compact normally.

interface.longDescription: At automatic Goal compaction, Relay attempts a genuinely fresh app-server continuation in the same repository and stops source compaction only after the handoff is verified. Failures defer to native compaction.
defaultPrompt: Keep Relay enabled while this Goal runs; at automatic compaction it attempts a verified fresh continuation and otherwise lets Codex compact normally.
In a destination thread, inspect live repository state and continue the same Goal objective without relying on the predecessor transcript.
